collectible.title: Ash's Ribbon
collectible.subtitle: It was a gift from Ash
collectible.text: Ash's ribbon he gave to her, she gave to you. Although, she might want it back.

collectible.title: Serena's Socks
collectible.subtitle: You know you want them,
collectible.text: You got them, cuz you really do like them.
collectible.unlock: After unlocking Ash's Handkerchief, get Serena to take off her socks in a follow up game. Ask her to buy them, then win against her.

collectible.title: Ash's Handkerchief
collectible.subtitle: She told you about it, were you listening?
collectible.text: This is the handkerchief Serena told you about. She must be fond of you, if she gave it to you, instead of giving it back to Ash.
collectible.unlock: Play a few times with Serena, and she will tell you the story about Ash and her at Pokemon Camp.
